subject: Shared document waiting
top_finding: Sender domain imitates a known domain

message.subject: Shared document waiting
message.excerpt: A document was shared with you. Sign in to view before your account is suspended.

findings.title: Sender domain imitates a known domain
evidence: Sender domain dhl-account[.]example wraps the name from dhl[.]com in extra words (imitating DHL)
findings.lesson: Read the domain letter by letter. Attackers register names that look right at a glance.

findings.title: Display name poses as a brand
evidence: Display name "DHL Team" claims DHL, sent from dhl-account[.]example
findings.lesson: The name on a message is free text. Check the address, not just who it says it is.

findings.title: Asks you to sign in, and fast
evidence: Wording asks for credentials under pressure: "sign in"; "account is suspended"
findings.lesson: Pressure plus a login request is the classic pairing. Pause, then go to the site on your own.

findings.title: Link is on throwaway hosting
evidence: dhl826[.]web[.]app is free hosting, used in a message that asks for action
findings.lesson: Free site builders are quick for attackers to spin up. A 'login' page on one is suspect.
